{{Breadcrumb Auto|parent=Game Mechanics}} '''Effects''' are certain conditions and modifiers that impact gameplay in various ways. These effects are viewable on the [[Galactic War|Galactic Map]]. The number of Effects and type vary by [[Biome]], [[Factions|Faction]], and [[Difficulty]]. ==Weapons Experimentation/Arsenal Augmentation== Occasionally, [[Federation of Super Earth|Super Earth]] High Command makes certain [[Stratagems]] available for [[Helldiver]]s to deploy with as an additional mission standard-issue stratagem. These augmentations are purely additive and do not take up a slot on a Helldiver's Stratagem loadout. == Democracy Space Station == The [[Democracy Space Station]] can provide a Helldiver-funded "Tactical Action" in addition to the Liberation Campaign boosting "Operational Support" to whichever planet is being orbited.
{{DSS Action|Eagle Storm}} {{DSS Action|Orbital Blockade}} {{DSS Action|Heavy Ordnance Distribution}}
{{DSS Action|Effects}}
==Environmental Conditions== Environmental conditions refer to geophysical events that influence a [[Planets and Sectors|Planet's]] environment, experienced throughout [[missions]]. * {{Environmental Conditions|Acid Storms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Blizzards}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Extreme Cold}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Fire Tornados}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Intense Heat}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Ion Storms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Meteor Storms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Rainstorms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Sandstorms}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Thick Fog}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Tremors}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Volcanic Activity}} * {{Environmental Conditions|Heavy Gloom Shroud}} * '''Moderate Gloom Blanket:''' The Gloom covers this planet completely, obstructing a variety of logistical operations. Extraction times are increased by 30 seconds and Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 20%. * '''Light Gloom Cover:''' Gloom particles interfere with landing Pelicans, increasing extraction times by 20 seconds. * '''[[Hive World|Gloom Source]]:''' This planet continually produces a thick atmospheric Gloom cover, rendering logistical support extremely challenging. Total Reinforcements are reduced by 20%, Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 30%, and Ammo from pickups is reduced by 50%. ===Operational Effects=== Sometimes, during certain events or Major Orders, some, if not all planets may gain an extra effect/modifier, available on all difficulties. * '''Orbital Fluctuations:''' All Orbital Stratagems have an increased cooldown. ''(not to be confused with the Operation Modifier with the same name, this effect only affects [[Stratagems|Orbital Stratagems]])'' * '''Medical Supply Strain:''' Number of stims each Helldiver deploys with decreased by 1. * '''Pilot Shortage:''' Extraction takes 30 additional seconds. * '''Slower Eagle Rearm:''' Eagle Rearm time is 25% slower. ==Operation Modifiers== Operation Modifiers are added obstacles that Helldivers must handle on the battlefield. A single Modifier will appear on {{Difficulty|5}}, increasing to two at {{Difficulty|8}}. Operation Modifiers do not appear on planets undergoing a [[Second Galactic War Mechanics#Defense Campaigns|Defense Campaign.]] ===General=== *[[Complex Stratagem Plotting]] – Stratagem Call-in time increased by 50%. *[[Orbital Fluctuations]] – Stratagem cooldown increased by 25%. *[[Poor Intel]] – Objective locations are hidden. *[[Civilians and SEAF in Area]] - [[SEAF Soldier]] squads and [[Civilian|Civilians]] are both on the battlefield. (Event modifier only present in [[Biomes#City Biomes|Metropolis Biomes]]) ===Faction-Specific=== {{Terminid|text}} *[[Atmospheric Spores]] – Map obscured by Bug Spores. *[[Roving Shriekers]] - Flying Shrieker swarms traverse the battlefield. {{Automaton|text}} *[[Gunship Patrols]] - Flying Gunships patrol the battlefield. {{Illuminate|text}} *[[Leviathan Blockade]] - Flying Leviathan warships patrol the battlefield. ===Removed=== *[[AA Defenses]] – Stratagem slots reduced by 1. *[[Atmospheric Interference]] – Orbital Stratagems Scatter Increased. *[[Electronic Countermeasures]] – Stratagem Codes Scrambled. == Combatant Forces == Some planets or cities will have modifiers that affect the types of units that spawn, whether it be friendly units or enemy ones, with them either increasing the frequency of specific units, replacing certain units with unique variants, or having entirely unique units. '''{{Terminid|text}}''' * Subfactions: ** [[Predator Strain]] - Unique cunning variants of [[Predator Hunter|Hunters]] and [[Predator Stalker|Stalkers]] will appear. ** [[Rupture Strain]] - Unique burrowing variants of [[Rupture Warrior|Warriors]], [[Rupture Spewer|Spewers]] and [[Rupture Charger|Chargers]] will appear. ** [[Spore Burst Strain]] - Unique explosive variants of [[Spore Burst Scavenger|Scavengers]], [[Spore Burst Hunter|Hunter]]s and [[Spore Burst Warrior|Warriors]] will appear. ** [[Dragonroach|Dragonroaches]] - [[Bile Titan|Bile Titans]] will be replaced with a unique flying enemy; the [[Dragonroach|Dragonroach.]] ** [[Hive Lord|Hive Lords]] - The colossal worm-like [[Hive Lord]] will appear. (Requires {{Difficulty|7}} or above.) '''{{Automaton|text}}''' * Subfactions: ** [[Jet Brigade]] - Unique [[Assault Raider]] units will appear alongside jetpack-equipped variants of [[Jet Brigade Trooper|Troopers]], [[Jet Brigade MG Raider|MG Raiders]], [[Jet Brigade Commissar|Commissars]], [[Jet Brigade Devastator|Devastators]], [[Jet Brigade Hulk Scorcher|Hulk Scorchers]] and [[Jet Brigade Hulk Bruiser|Hulk Bruisers]]. ** [[Incineration Corps]] - Unique [[Conflagration Devastator]] and [[Hulk Firebomber]] units will appear alongside incendiary-wielding variants of [[Pyro Trooper|Troopers]], [[Incendiary Rocket Raider|Rocket Raiders]] and [[Incendiary MG Devastator|Heavy Devastators]]. ** [[Cyborg Legion|Cyborgs]] - Unique cyborg [[Agitator]], [[Radical]] and [[Vox Engine]] units will appear. * Enemy Divisions: ** Hulk Surge - [[Hulk|Hulk units]] will spawn with increased frequency. ** Heavy Armor Surge - [[Tank|Tanks]] and [[Strider|Striders]] will spawn with increased frequency. ** Devastator Surge - [[Devastator]] units will spawn with increased frequency. '''{{Illuminate|text}}''' * Subfaction: ** [[Appropriators]] - Unique [[Obtruder]], [[Veracitor]], and [[Gatekeeper]] units will appear. ** [[Vote Snatchers]] - Unique [[Wretch]] and [[Crusher]] units will appear * Enemy Division: ** [[Mindless Masses]] - [[Voteless]] and [[Fleshmob]] units will spawn with increased frequency. ** [[Invasion Fleet]] - [[Voteless]], [[Overseer]], [[Crescent Overseer]], [[Elevated Overseer]], [[Fleshmob]], [[Watcher]], [[Harvester]] and [[Stingray]] units will spawn with increased frequency. '''{{Super Earth|text= Federation of Super Earth}} *Division: ** [[Heavy SEAF Presence]] - [[SEAF Soldier]]s will be deployed into mission areas via [[Pelican Shuttle|Pelican Shuttles]]. == Other Effects == === Armor Passives === [[Armor Passives]] are unique, player-specific abilities or enhancements that are tied to their corresponding body armors. Depending on the perk, different stat(s) will be affected, altering the way Helldivers can operate in the mission. === Boosters === Each Helldiver has the option to equip a [[Boosters|booster]] before deployment, which applies buff to the entire squad. Depending on the booster, it can alter a Helldiver's stats, certain pieces of equipment, or mission mechanics. === Status Effects === [[Status Effects]] are various status effects that can alter the Helldiver or their Enemies. These range to effects from the burning or gas effects of specific weaponry, to effects from stratagems, enemies, or environmental conditions. === Physical Conditions === [[Physical Conditions]] refer to adverse effects that a Helldiver may experience on the battlefield. These conditions can range from minor debuffs to being fatal if left untreated. Depending on the condition, it can be self-inflicted, caused by the environment, or applied by an enemy attack. The following effects exist in Helldivers 2. == Stagger and Ragdoll == Staggering can range from mere flinching to being knocked off your feet entirely. It is caused by dealing or taking damage with sufficient Stagger Force to meet an enemy's stagger thresholds. Higher thresholds impart stronger effects, such as completely interrupting animations. Unlike other status effects, Stagger Force does not build up over multiple attacks. ==== Enemies ==== * Staggering will cause an enemy to be pushed back and usually interrupts their movement, with the distance pushed scaling with Stagger Force. * Most enemies have abilities that can be interrupted upon being attacked with sufficient Stagger Force. ** Some notable interruptable abilities include certain attacks and calling for reinforcements. ** Stagger thresholds listed on enemy pages will be the value required to cause interrupting stagger. * Stagger Force required to interrupt an enemy can vary wildely, from the lowely [[Scavenger|Scavenger's]] 1 to the unyielding [[Fleshmob|Fleshmob's]] 45. * Weapons that fire multiple projectiles (Such as the [[SG-8 Punisher]]) will have every projectile apply full Stagger Force, allowing just a single pellet to stagger an enemy. ==== Stagger Force vs. Enemies ==== {| class="wikitable sortable mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"flamer |+ Stagger Threshold Table ! This does, however, have a plus of providing '''90%''' explosion damage reduction while in this state. * The [[Rock Solid]] armor passive '''reduces''' incoming stagger by '''30%'''. This effect lasts 4 seconds. * Can be inflicted by the following [[Terminids|Terminid]] Enemies: [[Caustic Spitter|Caustic Spitters]], [[Hunter|Hunters]], [[Caustic Warrior|Caustic Warriors]], [[Caustic Spewer|Caustic Spewers]], [[Nursing Spewer|Nursing Spewers]], [[Caustic Charger|Caustic Chargers]], [[Bile Titan|Bile Titans]], [[Bug Mine|Bug Mines]], [[Predator Hunter|Predator Hunters]], and all [[Spore Burst Strain|Spore Burst Strain Terminids]]. {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Acid Splash}} == Bleed == Inflicted on Helldivers from being injured in the chest or from coming into contact with either a [[Spike Plant|Spike Plant]] or a [[Automaton Barbed Wire|Barbed Wire]]. These all counts as separate effects. Deals damage over time.
{{Attack_Data/attack|status|Bleed}} {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Thornbush}} {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Barbwire}}
== Fire == * Can be inflicted by most fire-based weapons and stratagems;
Notable fire threats [[Environmental Hazards]] *[[Exploding barrels]] *[[Fire tornadoes]] *[[Volcano plants]] [[Enemies]] *Specific [[Automaton]]s **[[Hulk Scorcher]]s **[[Incineration Corps]] ***[[Pyro Trooper]]s ***[[Incendiary MG Devastator]]s ***[[Conflagration Devastator]]s ***[[Incendiary Rocket Devastator]] ***[[Hulk Firebomber]]s *[[Terminids|Terminid]] [[Dragonroach|Dragonroaches]] *[[Illuminate]] laser weapons **[[Harvester|Harvesters]] **[[Gazer|Gazers]] [[Helldiver]]s *[[Primary weapon]]s **[[AR-2 Coyote]] **[[SMG/FLAM-34 Stoker]] **[[FLAM-66 Torcher]] **[[LAS-5 Scythe]] **[[LAS-17 Double-Edge Sickle]] (overheating) **[[SG-225IE Breaker Incendiary]] **[[SG-451 Cookout]] *[[Secondary weapon]]s **[[LAS-7 Dagger]] **[[P-72 Crisper]] *[[Throwable]]s **[[G-10 Incendiary]] **[[G-13 Incendiary Impact]] **[[G-142 Pyrotech]] *[[Support weapon]]s **[[FLAM-40 Flamethrower]] **[[B/FLAM-80 Cremator]] **[[LAS-98 Laser Cannon]] **[[EAT-700 Expendable Napalm]] *[[Stratagem]]s **[[A/FLAM-40 Flame Sentry]] **[[A/LAS-98 Laser Sentry]] **[[Eagle Napalm Airstrike]] **[[Orbital Napalm Barrage]] **[[AX/FLAM-75 Hot Dog]] **[[AX/LAS-5 Rover]] **[[MD-I4 Incendiary Mines|MD-14 Incendiary Mines]]
Fire damage can penetrate {{Armor|4|AP}} armor and has an unmodified duration of 3 seconds. * Many entities have a fire damage multiplier. ** For instance, [[Caustic Spewer|Caustic Spewers]] take the standard amount of fire damage, but [[Impaler|Impalers]] take a 1.7x Fire Damage Multiplier due to being a larger enemy. {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Fire}} == Fire Panic == An effect similar to [[Status_Effects#Gas Confusion Mk1|Gas Confusion]], enemies hit by a direct stream of fire will move and attack randomly. Only direct-flame firing weapons such as the [[FLAM-40 Flamethrower]], [[B/FLAM-80 Cremator]], [[A/FLAM-40 Flame Sentry]], [[FLAM-66 Torcher]], and (uniquely) [[40-K Meltagun]] can apply this effect. Large/Massive non-[[Terminids|Terminid]] enemies are immune to this effect. {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Fire_Panic}} == Flamer Slowed == Enemies being hit by a direct stream of fire will be slowed. Only direct-flame firing weapons such as the [[FLAM-40 Flamethrower]], [[B/FLAM-80 Cremator]], [[A/FLAM-40 Flame Sentry]], [[FLAM-66 Torcher]], and (uniquely) [[40-K Meltagun]] can apply this effect. Large/Massive non-[[Terminids|Terminid]] enemies are immune to this effect. {{Attack_Data/attack|status|FlamerSlowed}} == Burning Heavy == An additional fire DPS inflicted by [[Eagle Napalm Airstrike]] and [[Orbital Napalm Barrage]], or shooting an enemy with the [[EAT-700 Expendable Napalm|Expendable Napalm]]. It inflicts significantly more damage than standard burning, but only lasts for 1 second after being inflicted on an enemy or Helldiver. * Burning Heavy also benefits from fire damage multipliers (such as the [[Enhanced Combustion]] ship module). {{Attack_Data/attack|status|BurningHeavy}} == Gas == Enemies and Helldivers afflicted by gas will suffer damage over time only to the Main health pool, as well as the Gas Confusion status effect on anything inside the gas cloud. The disorientation effect is delayed if the affected unit was already engaged in an attack motion (e.g. an [[Overseer]] chasing a Helldiver). ==== Gas Mk1 ==== * Duration: '''6''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[A/GM-17 Gas Mortar Sentry]], [[MD-8 Gas Mines]], [[G-4 Gas]], [[Orbital Gas Strike]], [[Eagle Gas Airstrike]], [[S-11 Speargun]] and [[P-35 Re-Educator]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Gas}} ==== Gas Mk2 ==== * Duration: '''10''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[TX-41 Sterilizer]], [[AX/TX-13 "Guard Dog" Dog Breath]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Gas_Var2}} == Gas Confusion== After being afflicted by Gas, enemies and Helldivers will enter a confused state which disrupts a Helldiver's vision, and causes enemies to move and attack in random directions, typically away from Helldivers. All units afflicted by gas are also slowed by 25%. ==== Gas Confusion Mk1 ==== * Duration: '''5''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[A/GM-17 Gas Mortar Sentry]], [[MD-8 Gas Mines]], [[G-4 Gas]], [[Orbital Gas Strike]], [[S-11 Speargun]] and [[P-35 Re-Educator]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Gas_Confusion}} ==== Gas Confusion Mk2 ==== * Duration: '''9''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[TX-41 Sterilizer]], [[AX/TX-13 "Guard Dog" Dog Breath]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Gas_Confusion_Var2}} == Stun == Enemies hit by stunning attacks will be unable to move or attack for a short time. Helldivers become severely slowed down. ==== Stun 1 [Small]==== * Duration: '''1.5''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[ARC-12 Blitzer]], [[ARC-3 Arc Thrower]], [[A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower]], [[AX/ARC-3 "Guard Dog" K-9]], [[G-31 Arc|G-31 Arc grenade]], [[GL-52 De-Escalator]], [[CQC-9 Defoliation Tool]], [[G-11 Caltrops]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Stun Small}} ==== Stun 2 [Medium]==== * Duration: '''3.0''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[A/M-23 EMS Mortar Sentry]], [[SMG-72 Pummeler]], [[AR-32 Pacifier]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Stun Medium}} ==== Stun 3 [Large] ==== * Duration: '''5.0''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[G-23 Stun]], [[G-109 Urchin]], [[SG-20 Halt]], [[CQC-19 Stun Lance]], [[CQC-30 Stun Baton]], [[CQC-1 One True Flag]] {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Stun Large}} ==== Stun 4 [Massive] ==== * Duration: '''10.0''' seconds. ** Inflicted by: [[Stun Pods]] booster. {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Stun Massive}} ==== EMS Stun ==== The [[Orbital_EMS_Strike|Orbital EMS Strike]] Stratagem, [[EMS_Mortar_Sentry|EMS Mortar Sentry]] Emplacement, and [[SEAF Artillery]] Static Field Shells inflict a special variant of Stun which creates a ''cloud of static'' that renders most enemies unable to move. Helldivers are severely slowed down and lose stamina while within EMS Stun clouds. == Poison == Poison refers to three separate statuses: Poison, Heavy Poison, and Poison Vulnerability. All three can only be inflicted by the [[Noxious Strain]]. === Poison and Heavy Poison === Poison and Heavy Poison are fairly similar in the fact that they both deal {{Damage|Acid|2/s Normal and 5/s Durable Acid Damage|notext}} for 6 seconds. The primary difference is in the fact that Heavy Poison blurs the player's screen for the duration. The true amount of damage dealt, however, is dependent on the amount of Poison Vulnerability stacks.
{{Attack_Data/attack|status|Poison}} {{Attack_Data/attack|status|Poison_Heavy}}
=== Poison Vulnerability === Poison Vulnerability multiplies the damage dealt by both Poison effects with each stack. * The poison damage is multiplied by 1.4x at 1 stack of Poison Vulnerability * Multiplied by 1.8x at 2 stacks * Multiplied by 2.8x at 3 stacks * Multiplied by 4.2x at 4 stacks This status effect only stacks up to four. Stimming will reduce the amount of stacks by 2, but will not stop the poison statuses from dealing damage. Additionally, from three stacks of vulnerability and onwards, when poison is applied, the Helldiver will lose their ability to sprint for the duration of the poison. '''Stimming does not help recover from the loss of sprinting''', therefore it is recommended to not let Poison Vulnerability stack more than twice. '''Exostorms''' are interstellar {{Illuminate}} [[Illuminate]] meteorological abnormalities that cause planetary weather to rapidly spike and intensify. These Exostorms have [[The Void|enormous consequences]] for space-time when not dealt with.

== Lore ==
{{Quote|Massive uncanny storms have erupted on this planet. These "Exostorms" emanate from otherworldly spires, unearthed by the Illuminate from the ruins of their fallen empire.|Partial Operation description of a '''Quell Exostorm''' Operation}}
{{Quote|Illuminate Exospires are channeling an aberrant Exostorm that rages on the surface of this world. The planet is at risk of being consumed by the Void, unless we act now.|Partial Operation description of an '''Avert Void''' Operation}}
Exostorms are caused by newly dug-up [[Destroy Exospire|Exospires]] located in Illuminate ruins. They send a purple beam into the sky, which stirs the weather up inside the mission area and beyond. Exostorms also affect the atmospheric integrity of the planet they are caused on.

Exospires are powered via an underground core fueled by [[Dark Fluid]] and protected by a shield generated by generators located in other nearby sites.

== Exostorm Classifications ==
=== Class 1 ===
{{Quote|Isolated Exostorm pockets are materializing across the planet and rapidly gaining momentum.|Class 1 Exostorm description}}

Class 1 Exostorms is the first Exostorm classification which begins after multiple Exospires have been activated.

* '''In-Mission''' - During Class One Exostorms, most weather-related [[Environmental Conditions]] a planet harbors will be permanently active. Lightning will rarely strike the ground after a short, but visible warning. The sky will also gain a massive slow-rotating cloud around the mission area.

* '''In-Orbit''' - The dark particles will begin exiting the atmosphere and entering into orbit, coating space near the planet in streaks of purple. The extensive weather effects can also be seen from space in the form of storms and vortexes.

* '''On the Galactic Map''' - On the galactic war map, a small purple vortex will appear beneath the planet. When enlarged on the galactic table, the planet will be colored in a purple hue while radiating streaks of purple outwards of the planet. The planet will also be displayed with small purple pockets.

=== Class 2 ===
{{Quote|Exostorm fronts are coalescing into a dense system that threatens to engulf the entire planet.|Class 2 Exostorm description}}

Class 2 Exostorms are more severe variants of Exostorms, now featuring tornados. They usually increase from Class 1 to Class 2 after 72 hours of an Exostorm beginning.

* '''In-Mission''' - During Class Two Exostorms, lightning strikes will become more common. Tornados will begin occasionally roaming the mission area, lifting items, living being and corpses into the air. Wind will also begin occasionally appearing on the surface. The massive cloud around the mission area will begin rotating faster. Vortexes will begin appearing outside the mission area, moving around slowly.

* '''In-Orbit''' - Many more dark particles will begin entering orbit as the purple streaks of energy intensify. The vortexes and storm clouds forming over the planet will begin growing in size.

* '''On the Galactic Map''' - The vortex beneath the planet in the galactic map will grow in size slightly. When enlarged on the galactic table, the radiant streaks of purple will intensify and grow in size, and the purple pockets displayed on the surface will increase in size and amount.

=== Class 3 ===
{{Quote|The Exostorm has reached critical mass, enveloping the planet in an ominous tempest that defies atmospheric physics.|Class 3 Exostorm description}}

Class 3 Exostorms are the final stage of an Exostorm, they are more intense than Class 1 and 2 Exostorms and feature spacetime tears. They usually increase from Class 2 to Class 3 after 120 hours of an Exostorm beginning. 

* '''In-Mission''' - During Class Three Exostorms, lightning strikes will be extremely common. The deadly tornados first seen in Class 2 become more common. Wind, while slow in earlier stages, now becomes perpetual and fast, in which a Helldiver's cape will not stop waving. The clouds will continue to rotate faster. Purple visual artifacts will now be extremely common. Tornados will continue to appear as in Class 2.
* '''In-Orbit''' - The dark particles reaching into the orbit will once again exponentially intensify and increase in size, erratically radiating purple streaks of energy. The vortexes and storm clouds over the planet will all have merged into one giant superstorm covering most, if not all of the planet at once.

* '''On the Galactic Map''' - The vortex beneath the planet on the galactic map will grow further, now spinning faster than before. When the planet is enlarged on the galactic table, the radiant streaks of purple intensify and grow further, and the purple pockets over the displayed surface will further increase in size. The outline of the displayed planet's hologram will also now become a deep purple. Within the [[Super Destroyer]], lights on the Bridge will turn a red/orange color.

* '''In-Lore''' - During Class Three Exostorms, fluctuations to the chronometric drift will start to occur, affecting the passage of time. Spacetime fractures will also envelop the planet's system, quickly compromising spacetime stability. Class Three Exostorms directly affect reality itself, slowly deteriorating it until the planet is plunged into the Void.

== The Void ==
''Main article: [[The Void]]''

After a planet has endured prolonged time covered by a Class 3 Exostorm and the enemy occupation rate reaches 100%, an impenetrable Void spanning hundreds of light years will form around the planet and the local system. The Void does not radiate any energy signatures and any probes sent in lose contact immediately after entering.

Any Helldivers stationed over a planet engulfed by the Void will be emergency FTL warped to [[Super Earth]], and will have any leftover Operations ceased as travel to the planet becomes impossible.

While the phenomenon was first observed around the [[Seasse]] system, the Void had spread to encompass over two dozen planets across the Illuminate front before it was collapsed on August 23rd 2186.

== Unique Effects ==
* '''Perpetual Meteorological Effects''' - Exostorms severely affect and intensify the weather of a harboring planet. For example on a [[Basic Swamp]] planet, it will perpetually rain as Basic Swamp biomes have the [[Rainstorms|Torrential Rainstorms]] environmental modifier active.
** Certain environmental effects will be missing completely, such as [[Acid Storms]] on [[Acidic Badlands]] planets, which are instead replaced by an unmarked Rainstorms effect.
** Geological environmental effects aren't spared either, with the [[Tremors]] effect missing completely from planets harboring them.
* '''Lightning''' - On Exostorm planets, lightning will occasionally strike the surface. While not outright deadly, lightning will deal some damage, as well as activating a short stun effect. A warning sign for a strike zone are particles, light, and warping around the strike zone.
** Note that at least during Class Three Exostorms, lightning strikes are deadly to most Helldivers wearing [[Medium|Medium Armor]] or lower.
* '''Wind''' - Wind can be seen on the surface. It does not negatively or positively affect any Helldivers or Enemies, however [[capes]] may begin to wave.
* '''Visual Artifacts''' - Purple visual artifacts caused by spacetime fractures can be seen around the mission area, appearing before shortly disappearing. While rare during Class One and Two Exostorms, they are very common during Class Three Exostorms.
* '''Tornados''' - Massive tornados can be seen roaming the surface in the mission area starting in Class Two Exostorms. These tornados lift up objects, living beings and corpses into the air, which is deadly for anything and anyone caught in one. Tornados become more common in Class Three Exostorms.

=== Environmental Changes ===
* From orbit, strands of purple energy can be seen leaving the atmosphere.
* The atmosphere will be filled with storm clouds similar to those found as hurricanes.
** These can be seen from orbit as massive covering clouds, or from the surface as if the mission area was inside the eye of the storm.
* The planet's surface will gain a faint, noticeable purple hue, rarely intensifying before returning back to usual.
** This effect is not caused by anything on the surface, but rather by the purple streaks in orbit which shine down onto the mission area.
* Light blue particles can be found floating around the surface of the planet.

=== Biome-specific Changes ===
While on most biomes Exostorms will have a normal effect that can be standardized, certain Biomes also receive unique changes during Exostorms.

* [[Desert Dunes]]: Both the [[Intense Heat]] and [[Extreme Cold]] environmental effects are completely removed. The [[Sandstorms]] modifier is also partially removed, not being present as an environmental effect, but present as an unmarked, permanent variant. This new sandstorm is less potent than its original form, but still lowers visibility exponentially, which affects enemies as well.
* [[Desert Cliffs]]: Both the [[Intense Heat]] and [[Tremors]] environmental effects are completely removed, and are instead replaced by an unmarked and lighter version of [[sandstorms]]. As part of this, the biome gains slightly thicker fog as grains of sand quickly fly through the air.
* [[Acidic Badlands]]: The [[Acid Storms]] effect is replaced by normal rainstorms, though they will not appear as an Environmental Condition in the effects tab. The usual thick fog will disappear and instead be replaced by a light purple fog present on other Exostorm biomes. When an Exostorm is destroyed, almost all the fog disappears, leading to a completely clear and fogless Acidic Badlands.
* [[Volcanic Jungle]]: The [[Volcanic Activity]] environmental modifier remains active and plays out as usual. As the effect is (likely) geological, destroying an Exospire to negate the exostorm's effects does not remove the possibility of volcanic rocks crashing onto the mission area.
* [[Deadlands]]: Unlike on other exostorm planets, exostorms on Deadlands planets do not feature any rain whatsoever. The usual fog is still present though with a more purple tint, followed by constant wind.
* [[Ethereal Jungle]] and [[Ionic Jungle]]: This biome features no rain or otherwise similar unmarked environmental effects. Fog is slightly thicker than usual and is combined with constant wind.
* [[Icy Glaciers]]: The [[Blizzards]] modifier is changed slightly, being permanently present. Unlike the original environmental effect, this blizzard does not affect movement, though it still lowers visibility exponentially. The lowered visibility affects enemies as well.
* [[Scorched Moor]]: The biome has no rain due to the heat, and instead features strong winds and a thick "ashen" fog. Notably, the [[Fire Tornados]] environmental effect unique to this biome is only present in the mission backdrop instead of as an active hazard.

'''Heavy SEAF Presence''' is a [[Effects|Modifier]] that allows SEAF squads to be deployed via [[Pelican Shuttle]]s to the mission area.

== Overview ==
The modifier was introduced as part of [[Campaigns#Void Piercer|Operation Void Piercer]]. On any planets where this modifier is active, SEAF soldiers will be deployed in missions via Pelican Shuttles.

Following [[Campaigns#Blazing Electorate|Blazing Electorate's]] failure on September 21st, 2026, {{PAGENAME}} was made unavailable. It was later added back on October 11th, 2026.<ref>"WARFRONT DEVELOPMENT - SEAF Battalions previously recalled to secure voting sites as detailed in the "Blazing Electorate" campaign are now returning to the frontlines. Trigger dicipline encouraged, democratic fervor mandatory." - Dispatch issued during [[Major Order#A3-10-3|Major Order A3-10-3]]</ref>

== Spawning ==
* Pelican Shuttles will periodically fly in to deploy up to 3 Squads of [[SEAF Soldier]]s to the mission area. Helldivers will know when this happens, as Mission Control will inform them.
** SEAF Squads are deployed on Helldivers fighting large amounts (estimated 20+) of enemies, or on enemy reinforcement call-ins. If neither is true, the SEAF Squads will remain in reserve.
** While there is a limit to the total active SEAF Squads deployed in a mission, there is no limit to the SEAF Squads in reserve. Pelican Shuttles will never run out of fresh SEAF Squads to deploy.

== Tactical Information==
* SEAF Soldiers deployed via this modifier always come in a general Squad composition consisting of 1 Squad Leader, 2 Riflemen, 2 Specialists, and 1 Medic. The SEAF Soldiers will follow their Squad Leader.
** For a proper description of these roles, please visit their [[SEAF Soldier|respective page]].
** Each deployed SEAF Soldier is always marked on the Helldivers mini-map with the small green dot.
* Each SEAF Soldier killed by direct actions of a Helldiver immediately deducts {{Currency|Requisition|25}} from the current amount for the [[Missions|Mission]]. This includes Soldiers killed by automated [[Stratagems]] such as the [[AX/AR-23 "Guard Dog"]] and [[A/G-16 Gatling Sentry]].
**The Pelican Shuttles that deploy the SEAF Soldiers often do so close to the Helldivers' position. As such, Helldivers should be aware of where they throw their Eagles, Orbitals, and Sentries to not kill the SEAF soldiers.
*** Pelican Shuttles will hold their descent if the area they are above is currently on fire or has any kind of offensive stratagem deployed. They will resume descending once the fire has dissipated or the offensive stratagem has ended.
** If a Helldiver is caught 9 times recklessly killing SEAF Soldiers or [[Civilian]]s, they will be branded as a traitor. As such, the [[Super Destroyer]] will begin firing [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage|380mm HE Shells]] at the Helldiver until they are killed. Mines will not add to the traitor tally but will still deduct Requisition Slips.
* The [[A/ARC-3 Tesla Tower]] does not react to SEAF Soldiers in its proximity. However, if an arc is triggered by someone else, it will still kill the SEAF Soldier.

== Trivia ==
* Although their default armor consists of the iconic light blue paint, save for the Medics, depending on the biome and super-structure, they will wear camo related to it.
** If they are on a Desert planet, such as a [[Desert Oasis]] biome like [[Fronteria]], they will be equipped with a desert-camo pattern.
* When SEAF squads were first added to the game, they are marked on the map as green dots, making them the first Ally NPCs to be identified on the map.
* Even when time has run out, Pelican Shuttles will keep spawning in and bring in fresh squads of SEAF Soldiers.

Paid for with the blood of soldiers and the credits of taxpayers, this technological marvel is Democracy made manifest.|Galactic War Table}} The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (abbreviated as '''DSS''') is a {{Super Earth|text}} Space Structure. It is designed to aid [[The Helldivers|Helldivers]] in their operations. == Mechanics == The Democracy Space Station's menu can be accessed from the '''Galactic Map''' interface; from there Helldivers can see a summary of the DSS, donate resources to activate powerful '''Tactical Actions''' and also '''vote''' on its next destination. === Moving And Voting === The movement of the DSS is dictated by a majority '''vote'''. Every 4 hours, the Helldivers are given a list of possible planets to vote on. Once the 4-hour period is over the DSS immediately warps to the winning planet's orbit and a new election begins. *If the current [[second Galactic War Mechanics#Liberation_Campaigns|campaign]] ends and there is no longer an active campaign on the orbited planet, the DSS will immediately move to orbit over the next planet with majority of votes. In case of majority vote being "Stay", the DSS will immediately move to the second most voted planet. **In these scenarios the 4-hour-timer however does not reset although Helldivers are given another vote-ticket to use. **In the case of a failed Defense Campaign the DSS will not immediately move if the subsequent Liberation Campaign is accessible. The list of votable planets is updated / refreshed during each movement of the DSS. === Tactical Actions === [[Helldiver|Helldivers]] can donate {{Currency|Requisition}}, as well as {{Currency|Commons}} and {{Currency|Rares}} in order to charge and activate '''Tactical Actions'''. Once fully charged, actions will immediately activate and provide its benefits to all operations occurring on the [[planets and Sectors|planet]] the DSS is orbiting. Each Helldiver can donate resources up to a cap (''separate for each resource'') within a 24-hour cycle; this period begins after the first donation since the end of the last participated cycle for that specific resource. The caps for each 24-hour donation cycle are: * {{Currency|Common Samples|75}} * {{Currency|Requisition|50,000}} * {{Currency|Rare Samples|50}} Only one '''Tactical Action''' can be active at a time. If an action reaches its full charge, it will freeze progress for all other actions until the current one is finished. After a '''Tactical Action''' concludes its 24-hour active period, it will enter cooldown and be ineligible for donations. * Occasionally, Tactical Actions may not be active for the hosting Helldiver during their first mission/gameplay session after booting up the game; this can be double-checked under the "Effects"-info-panel. The aforementioned situation can be rectified by either participating in an ongoing mission or completing a quick and easy/trivial mission first before hosting missions during active Tactical Actions.

=== Razing === Occasionally, the opportunity arises to raze a planet to the ground. Normally, the DSS will go offline for a period of time to do this. ===== The March to Cyberstan ===== During the March to Cyberstan, the Helldivers got an opportunity to raze the 3 planets on the way: [[Lesath]], [[Chort Bay]], and [[Merak]]. However, the Helldivers said no to Chort Bay and Lesath, but voted to raze Merak. After the failure to liberate [[Cyberstan]], it was found that the {{Cyborg Legion}} [[Cyborg Legion|Cyborgs]] threatened to take the remaining two planets. To counteract this, High Command put up a vote for the DSS to raze those planets, and the Helldivers agreed to raxe both planets, to ensure the Cyborgs never get their rusty hands on those vital planets. ===== Firebreak Protocol ===== In Operation: Serene Guardian, High Command issued the Firebreak Protocol, to cleanse the planets and put a definitive divider on the Terminid Front. Three planets were chosen to be razed: [[Acamar IV]], [[Gacrux]] and [[Partion]]. While the first two could be razed, [[Partion]] couldn't be liberated in time. ===== Planets ===== In total, 5 planets have been razed: * [[Lesath]] * [[Chort Bay]] * [[Merak]] * [[Acamar IV]] * [[Gacrux]] == Lore == === Retrieval === The plans for the Democracy Space Station were originally stored inside an Advanced Weapons Lab on [[X-45]] during the [[First Galactic War]], which was abandoned due to dangerous levels of radiation engulfing the planet. Once the radiation levels had decreased during the [[Second Galactic War]], the Helldivers were {{MajorOrderLink|id=A1-7-1|text=tasked with defending the planet}} from [[Automaton]] invasion while the lab was excavated by Super Earth forces in order to recover the plans for the station, as well as an intact cache containing the once lost [[MLS-4X Commando]]s. Upon successful retrieval of the plans, the lab it was formerly contained in was destroyed by Super Earth in order to prevent it from falling into Automaton control. === Construction === After a little over two months of research, construction of the Democracy Space Station was ready to begin. For the first stage of its construction, {{MajorOrderLink|id=A1-9-5|text=the Helldivers were tasked with choosing the location}} of the orbital construction site between either [[Clasa]] or [[Gaellivare]]. Both of these planets were considered suitable due to their large magnetospheres, but both were also under Automaton control, requiring the Helldivers to liberate their planet of choice to secure the site. The majority of Helldivers descended on Gaellivare and ultimately liberated it for the construction of the DSS. ==== Known Issues ==== *Beams in SECTOR 77C lacking structural integrity **Risk of collapse (See attachment A10) *E-710 drive combustion sparks unstable. Risk of self-combustion at use over 33mp/h *Insufficient space for lavatories. Removed to make space for sentry repair units. *Insufficient budget for pressure equalization Current pressure calculation is estimated -235 mmKG *Projections show Bedding for living spaces not within budget reach Donations from Super Citizen Anne's Hospital for Very Sick Children to compensate Reward children with. **[1] time held trip to DSS for heroic sacrifice for Democracy? === Phase 1 === On September 25th, 2184, Upon liberation, a [[DSS Logistics Hub]] on [[Tarsh]] was built to support the mass scale of the construction; Super Earth High Command determined that zero-g materials, FTL propulsion, and gigastructure staffing needed significant advancements to make the DSS a reality. High Command also reminded Helldivers that they would be crucial in the defense of the DSS should it come under attack, and any failures to do so would delay its construction. Soon after establishing the DSS, High Command began tasking the Helldivers to liberate planets to establish facilities for the advancements needed for the DSS. [[Turing]] was selected to build the Ministry of Science's new [[Xenoentomology Center]] for high-efficiency Alcubierre drives. Helldivers quickly liberated the planet from the [[Terminid]] swarm while also defending Tarsh's Logistics Hub. High Command noted that the Center would still need to be defended from any potential attacks or research will be lost. To create FTL-resistant alloy for the DSS, a deep-mantle forge would be required due to the extreme heat and pressure. Luckily, High Command found that the [[Automaton|Automatons]] on [[Claorell]] already had a deep-mantle mining complex. Seeking to repurpose it for their own ends, High Command ordered the Helldivers to liberate Claorell and seize the complex. They would be successful, filling the mines with Super Earth's own in the new [[Deep Mantle Forge Complex]]. However, High Command found intel that revealed that the Automatons were creating exceptionally light metal for armor plating. Not long after, the Automatons attempted to take back Claorell, accompanied by cyberattacks on DSS-related servers. The Helldivers would be successful in defending Claorell; the cyberattacks revealed the DSS project to the Automatons, but the DSS's exact location remained a mystery to them for the time being. === Phase 2 === On September 28th, 2184, with the [[Xenoentomology Center]] and [[Deep Mantle Forge Complex]] built, the DSS moved into Phase 2. Due to the DSS's scale, it would require significant amounts of [[E-710]], leading to the establishment of the [[Terminid Research Preserve]] on [[Acamar IV]]. It would provide research capabilities and another source of E-710. The Helldivers would need to liberate and hold the nearby planets of [[Crimsica]], [[Turing]], [[Darius II]], [[Pandion-XXIV]], and [[Gacrux]] to establish a planetary quarantine zone around Acamar IV. The Helldivers would successfully create the quarantine needed for the construction of the Terminid Research Preserve, furthering E-710 research. Shortly after, the Automatons would launch an assault division, the Jet Brigade, onto numerous planets in search of the DSS. Though the Jet Brigade managed to capture [[Matar Bay]] and [[Martale]], they were eventually stopped on [[Marfark]]. Due to the Helldivers' efforts, the Automatons were unable to find the DSS and its related facilities. To further protect the DSS, High Command determined that liberating [[Lesath]] would provide a defensive buffer for the DSS against a potential Jet Brigade assault. However, a sudden Terminid outbreak on [[Gacrux]] threatened the newly-built Terminid Research Preserve. The Helldivers were then left to decide which to prioritize, in which they chose to liberate Lesath. Another Terminid outbreak would occur on [[Pandion-XXIV]], eventually leading to its fall alongside Gacrux. The DSS would continue to stay protected, but the Terminid Research Preserve quarantine zone was now compromised. === Phase 3 === On October 26th, 2184, the continued protection of the DSS allowed it to advance to its final construction phase before its long-awaited completion. The DSS had to be staffed with a crew of nearly 1.3 million skilled workers. In order to get that many workers, the [[Ministry of Humanity]] authorized the relocation of colonists from [[Terrek]], [[Cirrus]], and [[Angel's Venture]]. Helldivers were ordered to hold these planets, and defend against attacks from within [[The Gloom]], while citizens on them were relocated to serve within the DSS. === Final Phase and Activation === On November 10th, 2184, construction of DSS was completed and the project reached its final phase. The entire construction took 43 days. In order to activate the DSS and fuel it, Helldivers were ordered to kill 500 million Terminids and hold [[Gaellivare]]. However the [[Jet Brigade]] returned, and attacked the [[DSS Logistics Hub]] on [[Tarsh]]. The capture of Tarsh led to the destruction of the Logistics Hub. High Command reported that its loss was negligible, as it had fulfilled its purpose and had an acceptable amount of citizen evacuations. However, they noted that the DSS was finally located by the Automatons, who were now preparing to attack [[Mastia]] to reach [[Gaellivare]]. Upon the culling of 500 million Terminids, the DSS was immediately fueled and activated. It proceeded to travel between various planets as the Jet Brigade attacked, achieving non-zero progress in each case. The DSS Eagle Storm would ultimately buy the citizens of Gaellivare enough time to evacuate before the planet fell into Automaton control. Despite losing the planet, this resulted in a "successful" Major Order win. === Apparent Sabotage and Deactivation === The DSS would patrol the Galaxy for the next several weeks, resulting in a quantifiable effect on the Galactic War. It cannot be argued that the DSS had zero effect, or that it was in fact negative for the forces on the ground. With the return of the [[the Illuminate|Illuminate]] and their {{MajorOrderLink|id=A1-12-3|text=attack}} on [[Calypso]]. The Democracy Space Station would undergo multiple catastrophic system failures, with the damage being severe enough to render it inoperable. The DSS was locked down for repairs. Security screening measures had been drastically increased. This sabotage, manifested in failure to follow security protocols, would later be attributed to Illuminate mind control. The DSS would remain marooned in orbit of [[Vog-Sojoth]] for over a month, unable to aid in the Galactic War against the return of the Illuminate. === Reactivation and Operational Adjustments === Necessary repairs would eventually bring the station online without further complications. Notably, its drives would receive a comprehensive recalibration, allowing the station to move every 4 hours rather than daily. This change was made to help better confront the swift pace of Illuminate attacks, and are under review for long term application. The DSS would exit Automaton space and begin coursing threatened planets at 6 times its previous speed. Beyond restoring basic functionality, these repairs would see tweaks to some core systems. In particular, the Planetary Bombardment tactical action would be temporarily retired so as to adjust certain lethal externalities caused by the ceaseless bombardment from the 77 PRESIDENTIAL-Class cannons installed on the DSS. A new tactical action with similar effects would take its place, with Heavy Ordnance Distribution providing the surplus [[Orbital 380mm HE Barrage]] stratagems to all Helldivers in the field. During [[Major Orders#A2-3-7|Major Order A2-3-7]] after the liberation of [[Ingmar]], it was also revealed the warp drives had been given enhancements to immediately deploy next planet after each completed campaign rather having to wait to cooldown recharge between each jump. === Upgrades === Following the [[Major Orders#A2-3-7|successful defense]] of [[Malevelon Creek]], upgrades to the DSS became a priority due to its pivotal role in holding [[Pöpli IX]]. Helldivers were ordered to [[Major Orders#A2-4-1|secure resources for the upgrade]], by liberating either [[Wezen]] to enable the construction of an Exosuit Support Bay, or [[Trandor]] for an Expanded Convocation Bay. Upon the liberation of the [[Automatons|Automaton]] factories on Wezen, the Exosuit Support Bay was installed immediately, reducing the cooldown of Exosuit [[Stratagems]]. === Second Deactivation === {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-5-2|text=During the true Illuminate invasion}} on [[Widow's Harbor]], Super Earth High Command reported in a dispatch that the DSS, which was orbiting the planet, received damage from the Illuminate. High Command warned that further warps to Illuminate-invaded planets could potentially deal additional damage. Despite their warning, the Helldivers would vote for the DSS to warp to [[Pilen V]] soon after the fall of Widow's Harbor. The Illuminate immediately attacked the DSS upon its arrival to Pilen V, inflicting significant damage to the station and killing many of its crew. The DSS would retreat to [[Claorell]] for repairs, though Super Earth High Command noted that it is undetermined of when the DSS would be fully operational. === Second Reactivation & Surge into Action === After receiving sufficient repairs due to {{MajorOrderLink|id=A2-5-5|text=Helldivers collecting Automation scrap}}, as ordered by High Command, the DSS immediately left for Super Earth without delay. Upon reaching Super Earth, it began supporting the struggling defense against the Illuminate invasion. In order to avoid a repeat of its previous near-destruction, high command initialized a Fleet Positioning Protocol, creating a barrier of ships around the DSS to defend it against enemy fighter attacks. === Star of Peace === Following the construction of the [[Center for the Confinement of Dissidence]], Super Earth High Command ordered the construction of [[Pandora Base]] within [[Afoyay Bay]]. The new top-secret base would utilize the Dissident's labor in order to accomplish one of [[Major_Orders#January_2026|Operation Free Space]]'s main goals: a major augmentation of the DSS called ''Star of Peace''. Such upgrade's centerpiece was the installation of an ionized ''"The centerpiece of this Operation is the Star of Peace, created to augment the Democracy Space Station.'' ''Its primary weapon is a cutting-edge beam of ionized Dark Fluid."'' - {{MajorOrderLink|id=A3-1-1|text= Major Order A3-1-1 briefing}} [[Dark Fluid]] beam capable of {{MajorOrderLink|id=A3-1-4|text=collapsing an entire planet}} into a black hole. [[Strohmann_News#Star of Peace Announced|Strohmann News broadcast: Star of Peace Announced]][[Strohmann News#Star of Peace Completes Test Fire|Strohmann News broadcast: Star of Peace Completes Test Fire]] On January 14th, 2186, after {{MajorOrderLink|id=A3-1-1|text=barely collecting enough E-711 from Omicron}} and {{MajorOrderLink|id=A3-1-2|text=successfully collecting platinum and scrapping Automaton components}}, the [[Democracy Space Station#Star of Peace|Star of Peace]] would be able to be fired once in order to turn an entire planet into a black hole using synthesized [[Dark Fluid]]. The choices were between [[Penta]], [[Zagon Prime]], and [[Valmox]]. When the Star of Peace reached operational status, the Helldivers elected for Penta to be used as the demonstration for test-firing. On January 18th, 2186, day 711 of the Galactic War, at 21:28 SEST, Penta would be destroyed and turned into a [[Conventional Black Hole]], a normal, stable black hole much unlike the [[Meridian Black Hole|Meridian Singularity]]. === Operation Valid Pretext=== On February 10th, 2186, the DSS would be deployed on [[Cyberstan]] as part of [[Operation Valid Pretext]], providing support to Helldivers and SEAF forces on the planet. On February 15th, 2186, the DSS would be sent to [[Fort Justice]] briefly to recover 35,000,000 Helldivers in cryostasis stored in warehouses. The DSS remained on the planet for 12 hours before returning with the 35,000,000 Helldivers. On February 19th, 2186, seeing Operation Valid Pretext's failure was imminent, High Command activated the '''TERMINAL DIRECTIVE''', initiating the DSS' Planetary Bombardment tactical action for 48 hours. == Description == === Phase 1 === {{Quote|Construction has begun on the Democracy Space Station. The local populace is honored to host thousands of construction crews for this historic event.}} === Phase 2 === {{Quote|Democracy Space Station construction is well underway. The local economy is flourishing as the planet's populace has centupled, and all the Galaxy can feel their democratic fervor.}} === Phase 3 === {{Quote|Construction of the Democracy Space Station is nearing completion. This project, which has employed millions, will soon take its place among the greatest achievements of Democracy.}} === Final Phase === {{Quote|A Helldiver-operated weapon of mass liberation. Paid for with the blood of soldiers and the credits of taxpayers, this technological marvel is Democracy made manifest.}} == Trivia == * Despite requiring over 1.3 million skilled workers to sustain operations ''"The Democracy Space Station is currently in its third construction phase. Before it can be activated, it must be staffed, which is no small task for such a stately behemoth.'' Supercolony.description: Entirely unforeseeable mutations from the Termicide led to hyper-accelerated bug growth on this planet, turning it into a Supercolony. It is corrupted beyond saving. The bugs infest every inch of it, down to the mantle, spawning trillions of spores every day.

Volcanic Jungle.description: Abundant with life, this wet planet is covered in deep oceans, thick forests, and tall grasses.

Haunted Swamp.description: Squelching mud, twisting roots; the odor of rot and anarchy. A teeming, endless morass.

Icy Glaciers.description: Submerged in eternal winter, this world's frosty peaks glimmer in the light of its too-distant star.

Boneyard.description: Ice and moss-covered rock can be found across most of the surface of this planet.

Basic Swamp.description: Tall, gnarled trees flourish across the surface of this forested world. Sunlight filters past dangling vines, to the saturated undergrowth below.

Desert Dunes.description: A blazing-hot desert planet, its rocky mesas are the sole interruptions to the endless sea of dunes.

Acidic Badlands.description: Dense, toxic fumes from deep within the planet's crust seep out of cracks in the earth and coat the ground in a sickly haze.

Moon.description: A rocky, lonely moon with extremely valuable mineral deposits underneath the surface.

Rocky Canyons.description: This arid, rocky biome covering this world has driven the evolution of exceptionally efficient water usage in its various organisms.

Desert Cliffs.description: A desert planet prone to unpredictable and dangerous sand twisters.

Deadlands.description: The lifeless grey of this planet is interrupted only by the violet flowers that grow from strange, parasitic outcroppings.

Ethereal Jungle.description: This world teems with ethereal, boundless, and peculiar plant life that spreads silent and uninterrupted across its entire surface.

Ionic Jungle.description: The strange subversion of photosynthesis that sustains the oddly-hued flora that flourishes on this planet remains an intriguing mystery to Super Earth's greatest exo-biologists.

Plains.description: Rocky outcroppings punctuate fields of tall grass in a planet dominated by misty highland terrain.

Tundra.description: A perenially chilly climate has allowed short, colorful shrubs to flourish across this planet's surface.

Scorched Moor.description: Scorching temperatures, high winds, and low precipitation cause a near-constant cycle of fires to sweep this planet, punctuated by short bursts of lush rebirth between infernos.

Ionic Crimson.description: A crimson algae has propagated wildly across this entire planet, coating its rocky hills with a constant red that masks the spilt blood of the heroes who defend it from tyranny.

Super Earth Metropolis.description: The blinding beacon that illuminates the stars with the light of Democracy. The patriotic paradise for citizens who truly serve their Federation. And the utopian future awaiting the entire galaxy.

Hive World.description: This planet has been completely infested by the Terminids, transformed inside and out into a hive of Tyranny.

Magma Desert.description: Constant eruptions keep this planet covered in lava flows and utterly inhospitable to Democratic life. It also makes it a treasure trove of rare minerals.

Cyberstan Megafactory.description: Cyberstan, once again, forms the axis of the Cyborg Legion's insurrection. Massive Megafactories cover its surface, churning out mechanical armies and weapons of mass extinction.

Automaton Mine.text:
{{Infobox Hazard | title=Automaton Mine | image=Automaton_Mine.png | description=When stepped on by a creature or otherwise damaged, it explodes and damages anything nearby. | type=Automaton Hazards | locations= Automaton Missions }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' (officially '''Contact Mine'''), is a red and black contact mine constructed by the {{Automatons|text}}. It is an [[Environmental Hazards|Environmental Hazard]] found scattered around perimeters of the Automaton occupied zones, such as [[Automaton Outpost|Outposts]] and most [[Minor Places of Interest]] {{Difficulty|7}} onwards. == Effect == When stepped on by a creature or otherwise damaged, it explodes and damages whatever is nearby. == Detailed Statistics ==
{{Attack_Data/attack|explosion|Cyborg_Mine}}
== Locations == This hazard can only be found on Automaton Missions. As mentioned above, mines may be expected near any specific landmark where Automatons have stationed defenders. Mines become increasingly common as difficulty rises, to the point that they may be discovered '''in open terrain'''. == Anatomy == [[File:Automaton_Mine_Stage_Two.png|thumb|alt=|Automaton mine with lights off, in second stage trigger. ]] The Automatons' mines are volatile enough that a detailed breakdown of their damage zones would be redundant. There is a two-stage trigger state. If you move close enough (1-2m) you can trigger the first stage and get the lights to shut off. [https://medal.tv/games/helldivers-2/clips/lEYldYTTE3UfF4n3a?invite=cr-MSw4OUosNDA4OTUzMzIw&v=28 Video evidence.] == Tactical Information == * Using the 'tag location' command while pointing one's reticle at a Contact mine will place a temporary marker above that mine and issue a generic "Danger" vocal call out. * It is extremely unlikely to survive stepping on a Contact Mine without the [[Democracy Protects]] or [[Fortified]] armor passive effect. ** A Fortified heavy armor such as the [[FS-11 Executioner]] will leave its wearer with roughly 1/3 of their health if they step on a mine while in perfect condition. ** Using the [[SH-32 Shield Generator Pack]] has the potential to negate the effect of one mine. This will fully drain the shield pack, necessitating a recharge period. * Automatons tend to place their mines in logical positions that impede traffic toward areas that [[Helldivers]] would find desirable. ** The alternative entrances of Heavy Outposts, Fortresses, and [[Detector Tower]] hills are all extremely likely to be mined. Areas adjacent to the primary entrances may also be mined. ** [[Colonies]] will often be mined at breaches in their outer wall. ** Alleyways and intersections may be mined inside of occupied [[Mega City|Mega Cities]] and Colonies. ** The smaller underground variant of the [[Bunker]] place of interest tends to be heavily mined on higher difficulties. * Automaton Mines are extremely sensitive to damage. Gunfire and explosions can detonate them easily. ** Beam weapons such as the [[LAS-5 Scythe|LAS-5]] are preferable for mine clearing due to their uninterrupted stream of damage and (hypothetically) infinite ammunition. ** Automaton forces will attempt to avoid stepping on their own mines, but may still pass close enough to be damaged by one if detonated by an outside force. == Change History == {{Change History Head}} {{Change History Update|1.006.300|changes= Fix * Fixed Automaton mines getting under ground after a nearby mine explodes }} {{Change History Update|1.000.000|changes= Initial release of the game or otherwise simply a placeholder section. }} == References == [[Category:Bot Hazards]] [[Category:Environmental Hazards]] {{Nav Mechanic}}

Lava.text:
{{Infobox Hazard
| title=Lava
| image=Lava Lake.png
| description=Pools and rivers of molten lava, will ignite Helldivers upon contact
| type=Terrain
| locations= [[Magma Desert]], [[Automaton Megafactory]], [[Cyberstan Megafactory]]}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Environmental Hazards|Environmental Hazard]], found in abundance in [[Magma Desert]] planets, and occasionally in the form of concrete pits in [[Megafactory|Automaton Megafactory]] structures.

== Effect ==
* Anything coming into contact with lava will instantly ignite, dealing {{Damage|Fire|100 DPS|notext}} and constantly re-igniting entities until any contact with the lava ceases.
* Touching the lava will also deal a small amount of extra damage.

== Location ==
* Similarly to water on certain planets, lava can come in the form of lakes and seas, being found around the edges of mission areas and in large lakes separating large sections.
** Most of the time, these lakes will be large, requiring anything desiring to cross them to find an alternative route.
** Occasionally, {{Automaton}} [[Automaton|Automaton-built]] bridges can be found, allowing the lake to be crossed quickly and easily.
* Lava can also be found in the form of rivers, flowing across the surface and between crevices and rock formations.
** Rivers can easily be avoided by diving over them, as they are usually not very wide.
* Rarely, tiny lava pockets can be seen on the rocky surface of a planet, being on average not much bigger than a human.
* Occasionally, lava can be found in large concrete cutouts of the terrain on [[Megafactory]] structures.
** Tiny pockets on the surface may rarely also be seen.

== Tactical Information ==
* Walking over lava is not advised as the Helldiver will immediately be set on fire and take 100 damage per second, killing them in just around a second, depending on armor.
** As is standard for being set on fire, diving will immediately stop the fire. However when diving on lava, the Helldiver will be instantly re-ignited.
** The use of certain [[Armor]] with passives such as [[Inflammable]] and [[Acclimated]], and [[boosters]] such as the [[Vitality Enhancement]] booster can delay death by a few seconds.
* While vehicles can also cross over lava, usage of them on lava is also not advised, especially for longer periods of time.
** The [[M-102 Fast Reconnaissance Vehicle]] is not recommended  for crossing lava.
*** Once the FRV comes into contact with lava, the rubber tires will immediately catch on fire and explode, making any future steering extremely difficult.
*** The main body of the FRV will also catch on fire, exploding after about 10 seconds.
** Both the [[EXO-45 Patriot Exosuit]] and the [[EXO-49 Emancipator Exosuit]] can be used to cross  smaller patches of lava such as rivers, but this will damage the exosuit. its legs in particular.
* Anything landing on lava that comes inside a Hellpod, such as Helldivers, emplacements, turrets and [[Support weapon]]s will not catch on fire as they are protected by the Hellpod.
* Enemies such as the {{Automaton}} [[Automaton Legion]] cannot pathfind over lava, so if they happen to spawn on an island surrounded by lava with no way off of it, they will be unable to move.
** Stuck Automatons may still shoot back if they spot the Helldiver.

'''{{PAGENAME}}s''' are an unique feature of [[Magma Desert|Magma Deserts]]. They are an [[Environmental Hazards|Environmental Hazard]].

== Effect ==
Lava Geysers are small to medium-sized bits of terrain, with a pocket of lava in the middle. These often explode, which is safe at a distance.

* Usually, these geysers are calm, being little more than a rock.
* Every ~20 seconds though, the ground will begin to shake and the core of the geyser will begin to bubble with lava.
* After a few seconds of bubbling, the geyser will explode, spurting out lava and molten rocks, setting anything standing too close on fire and launching them away with a shockwave, which can sometimes prove deadly.

== Location ==
Lava geysers can be found on [[Magma Desert]]s on the ground, usually near streams of [[Lava]] and occasionally inside places of interest.

| title = Shrub
| image = Caustic Badlands Shrub.png

| type = Flora

'''Shrubs''', or '''Ferns''' depending on the [[Biomes|Biome]], are hindering plants of various shapes and colors.

== Effect ==

Both creatures and Helldivers become slower whilst walking through a Fern or Shrub. However, this is greatly negated for Helldivers when using the [[Muscle Enhancement]] [[Boosters|Booster]].

Additionally, when a Helldiver is crouching or prone inside of a Shrub, it reduces detection range from enemies, allowing enemy patrols to stroll right past a Helldiver. A black vignette surrounds the screen to confirm that you are concealed. Though, since hiding in a Fern or Shrub only hides a Helldiver visually, unsuppressed weapons and/or standing too close to the enemy can still alert them to your position.

== Location ==

Ferns and Shrubs can be found in any Biome excluding [[Extreme Cold]] biomes; specifically [[Boneyard]], [[Icy Glaciers]], and [[Moon]].

It is considered an [[Environmental Hazards|Environmental Hazard]]. == Effect == When a creature attempts to move near it, it slows the creature, drains stamina, and damages it for as long as it is still near the weed. When damaged, it explodes into exploding shrapnel, knocking close creatures back, and releasing 3 bursts of damaging spikes. == Tactical Information == * Helldivers should be careful when near spike plants, as the point-blank shrapnel explosion can easily launch and possibly kill Helldivers, even when equipped with heavy armor. * Additionally, even when driving [[FRV|FRVs]], Helldivers should avoid running into spike plants, as the shrapnel can pop wheels, damage the FRV, and can injure Helldivers onboard. ** Using the [[LIFT-182 Warp Pack]] with the warp destination being within the bounds of the spike plant will instantly kill the Helldiver. == Detailed Attack Statistics ==

== Locations == * They can be found on Primordial [[Biomes]], such as the [[Deadlands]], [[Ethereal Jungle]], [[Volcanic Jungle]], and [[Ionic Jungle]] biomes. ** In Ionic Jungle biomes, Spike Plants' bulbs wear a bright emerald green hue instead. Intense Heat.text:
{{Breadcrumb Auto|parent=Environmental Conditions|overview=Conditions}}
{{Quote|High temperatures increase stamina drain and speed up heat buildup in weapons.|Galactic War Map}}

{{Environmental Conditions|Intense Heat}}

== Effects ==
Intense Heat is applied depending on the time of day and weather conditions. Planets with [[Fire Tornados]] will activate the Intense Heat modifier only for the duration of the Fire Tornado storm. 
* Maximum stamina is halved. This means it takes half as long for a Helldiver to become winded from constant sprinting, but it also means they regain their maximum stamina in half the usual time (because the rate of stamina regen is unaffected).
* Heat-based weapons lose heat slowly, contrary to the in-game description of increasing build-up. This means that once overheated, it takes longer for the weapon to cool down, usually by a factor of 33% relative to it's normal cooldown duration.<ref>[https://youtu.be/okeILhqZc4o Helldivers 2 - Laser Cooldowns Tested on Hot vs Cold Planets]</ref>

* [[Scorched Moor|Arid planets]] (similar to the [[Hellmire]] planet) will now only have the Intense Heat modifier active during [[Fire Tornados|fire tornado]] storms.

The Bug Spores has a number of effects which obstruct the intelligence acquisition of the mission map:
*Topography is heavily obscured.
*Enemy (Terminid) unit "blips" won't appear the minimap.
*[[Spawn Mechanics|Areas of Influence]] (AoI) become extremely difficult to make out due the blending colours, effectively rendering Bug Nests and other AoI-heat-zones completely invisible on the minimap.
**Even after destruction, the Bug Nests remain unmarked on the minimap.

Completing the [[LiDAR Station]] Optional Objective will place markers on the minimap for every point of interest; however, Terminid-units including [[Bug Hole|Bug Holes]] remain hidden from the minimap.
